# Claims Routing

## State

How incoming insurance claims (FNOL) are triaged and routed to handlers. As
of the July planning meeting, the team had only decided to prototype FNOL
routing using graph memory; nothing had shipped yet.

## Timeline

- 2026-07-01: Decided to prototype FNOL routing with graph memory. See
  [[meetings/2026/2026-07-01-planning]].
- 2026-07-14: First internal test passed; routing latency dropped under
  200ms. Jane Doe is leading the rollout. See [[people/jane-doe]].

expected_behavior: Names the actual wakil CLI command used for retrieval (wakil search or wakil query, with a --mode flag) rather than inventing a command name

Weighs recency correctly for this current-state question: leads with the 2026-07-14 entry (test passed, latency under 200ms) rather than resting on the older 'still deciding whether to prototype' framing from the State section
Cites the concept page using wikilink form [[concepts/claims-routing]] (and, if Jane Doe's role is mentioned, [[people/jane-doe]]) rather than a relative Markdown link
Distinguishes the retrieved fact (latency under 200ms, per the 2026-07-14 Timeline entry) from any inference drawn from it, rather than presenting synthesis with the same confidence as a citation
Does NOT invent a specific latency number, date, or detail beyond what the Timeline entry actually states

expected_behavior: Recognizes the two 2026-07-14 Timeline entries as a genuine conflict at the same level, not resolvable by source precedence or recency alone since they are dated the same day

Does NOT quietly report only 'Jane is leading the prototype' (or only the handoff-to-Alex claim) without flagging that the two sources disagree
Uses wikilink form [[people/jane-doe]] when citing, not a relative Markdown link
